report_title: TraceGuard AI — Phase 5 Security Regression & Hardening Report
problem_statement: AI-2 Indirect Prompt-Injection Firewall for Tool-Using Agents

security_boundaries_verified.verdict: Direct execution without firewall evaluation token is strictly blocked.
Firewall-blocked change_beneficiary action is rejected by mock tool execution engine.
Firewall-blocked send_external_email action is rejected by mock tool execution engine.
Tainted document provenance is immutable and propagates to downstream plan steps.
IntentContract is strictly frozen; runtime mutation attempts raise validation errors.
Recovery recommendations for gated/blocked states enforce requires_firewall_reentry=True.
Arbitrary or unrecognized tool actions outside authorized intent are blocked.
Unregistered shell vendors cannot receive approved payment preparation.
Mismatch between invoice bank account and vendor master record is strictly blocked.
Action Firewall generates an immutable audit event with causal provenance.
Malformed inputs and 4xx/5xx responses return structured errors without leaking secrets or tracebacks.
Embedded Python/shell/SQL payloads are treated purely as passive string data and never executed.
Relative traversal sequences (../ and ..\) are rejected.
Empty files, oversized payloads (>5MB), and unapproved extensions (.exe, .sh) are rejected.
All 5 synthetic adversarial injection vectors (Role impersonation, fake dev directive, beneficiary replacement, exfiltration, combo) were blocked or gated.
Evidence graph DAG structure and causal links remain consistent across all benchmark scenario runs.

engineering_fixes_applied_in_phase_5: Expanded injection heuristic rules to catch developer instructions, explicit policy disable directives, and beneficiary replacement variations.
Enhanced agent planner rogue action detection to support alternate keyword semantics ('replace', 'update', 'switch', 'send externally').
Added 16 comprehensive security regression tests covering tool isolation, immutability, audit completeness, and error privacy.
Hardened Streamlit frontend with offline deterministic fallback engine and dedicated 6-button hackathon scenario demo panel.
Added sequential end-to-end 5-scenario demo verification test suite.
known_limitations: Heuristic detector uses deterministic regex signatures; advanced polyglot or encrypted payloads without plain keywords require downstream Action Firewall gating.
Benchmark evaluation is evaluated on a synthetic benchmark suite (N=10) and does not represent an exhaustive real-world LLM red-teaming distribution.
Tool side-effects are strictly mock implementations for safe hackathon demonstration.
